model_scope: Provisional incompressible solid N2O for low-pressure gas-solid equilibrium; not a validated high-pressure solid EOS

solid.table-units: Temperature K; Cp J/kmol/K; fusion enthalpy J/kmol; molar volume m^3/kmol

domain.pressure_limit_basis: Explicit provisional low-pressure ceiling. The source available here does not validate solid compressibility or pressure-volume work at the fluid model's 50 MPa ceiling.

reference.solid_h_reference: h_liquid_PR(Tref,pref) - 6516*1000/molecularWeight, converting J/mol to J/kmol before division by kg/kmol
reference.solid_s_reference: s_liquid_PR(Tref,pref) - (6516/Tref)*1000/molecularWeight, converting J/mol/K to J/kmol/K before division by kg/kmol

molar_volume.source_statement: Atake dissertation discusses a molar volume of about 40 cm^3 in its solid-N2O analysis; it also states that only two density values, at 20 K and 83 K, were available for calorimeter corrections.
molar_volume.limitation: No precise density or thermal-expansion data near 148-182 K were available in the accessible primary text. Use only under the explicit 0.2 MPa ceiling and retain sensitivity checks.

heat_capacity.integration: exact analytic integral of Cp=a+b*T for enthalpy and Cp/T for entropy
heat_capacity.endpoint_183: Linearly continued from the sourced 181 K and 182 K slope: 58.88 + (58.88-58.58) = 59.18 J/mol/K. The 182-183 K segment is a declared short extrapolation so a slightly shifted numerical melting point can be tested and rejected by phase stability.

sublimation_validation.requirement: Independent validation: pure-gas and solid chemical potentials should reproduce this measured sublimation curve over the implemented 148-182.408 K overlap without fitting the solid reference to the validation points.

sources.citation: T. Atake and H. Chihara, A New Condensed Gas Calorimeter. Thermodynamic Properties of Solid and Liquid Dinitrogen Oxide, Bulletin of the Chemical Society of Japan 47 (1974) 2126-2136, DOI 10.1246/bcsj.47.2126
sources.data: Heat capacity 1.9-184 K, triple point, fusion enthalpy, vapor pressure

sources.citation: T. Atake, Osaka University dissertation, experimental Tables 9-14 and equations (9)-(10)
sources.data: Integer-temperature Cp table, fusion measurement, triple point, solid sublimation correlation and measured pressures

known_limitations: The 183 K Cp endpoint is a declared 1 K linear extrapolation from the 181-182 K slope, not a measured table entry.
The molar volume is approximate and the solid is modeled as incompressible.
The model supplies no intrinsic solid sound speed or compressibility and requires a nonzero gas phase for mixture pressure sensitivity.
All-solid states and pressures above 0.2 MPa are outside this model.
